Smart packages

Basic, Comfort and Premium, side by side.

Three tiers, installed and commissioned before handover. Choose on what the house can do, not on how many devices are in the box.

Basic

KES 480K

The essentials. Lights, locks and a smart meter you can read from your phone.

  • Devices14
  • Installation4 days
  • Power saving12%
  • Water saving8%

Security

  • Smart front door lock with keypad
  • Door and window contact sensors (6)
  • Indoor motion sensor (2)
  • Entry camera doorbell

Lighting and power

  • Smart switches (8 circuits)
  • Dimmable living room control
  • Smart energy meter with app reporting

Climate and water

  • Smart thermostat (1 zone)
  • Water tank level sensor
  • Leak detection under the sink

Connectivity and support

  • TRIXX Home Hub with 4G backup
  • TRIXX Home app for the whole family
  • 2-year warranty, remote support

Not included

  • —Solar and battery
  • —EV charger
  • —Farm plot sensors
  • —Automated irrigation
